target_customer: AI research labs and robot developers
problem: Geared robot joints add backlash and wear and hurt sim-to-real transfer; gearless transverse-flux joints aim to fix this.
business_model: Hardware sales of robot arms and joints

founders.name: Charles Yong
founders.background_notes: Per one profile the company originated in MIT's DesignX accelerator (scroll.media, undated)

technical_complexity.rationale: Novel high-torque transverse-flux direct-drive motors are hardware R&D; prototype rated 3 N.m per own site.

defensibility.rationale: Motor design know-how is hard to copy; no patent evidence found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found; no sourced evidence either way.

market_need_then: Embodied-AI labs need precise, affordable arms and actuators for data collection and sim-to-real transfer (company positioning); the company reports 200+ robots delivered (self-reported).

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical, direct: 'We build the joint. You build the intelligence.'

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: We build the joint. You build the intelligence.

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the name, logo or community found; too little to rate.

outcome_analysis: Vassar Robotics is a Spring 2025 YC hardware company building gearless transverse-flux robot joints and arms, listed Active and early. Directory profiles describe both semi-humanoid open-source developer arms and gearless joints for AI labs, so positioning may have shifted, and aggregators place it in San Francisco, Los Angeles or Boston inconsistently. Funding is reported only as roughly $500K (likely the YC deal) by aggregators, so there is no verified outcome beyond being early, and no success or failure factors are asserted.
notes: Searches done: outcome (no acquisition or shutdown found), funding (and a cross-check inside the same results: PitchBook $510K with YC, MITdesignX, Network VC and Sapienta; VCBacked $500K pre-seed Jun 2025), competitor, branding. Both are aggregators, the scroll.media piece names Network VC as an investor but no amount was seen, so the funding is unverified and not recorded as a round. Competitors: Genesis Robotics (LiveDrive direct-drive actuators) and ETM (transverse flux) appear in articles whose dates I could not confirm near March 2025, so none are listed. The name Vassar has no sourced origin; name_type 'other' replaces the earlier unverified person_or_place guess. Location conflicts across sources (Boston per directory, San Francisco, Los Angeles on YC jobs page). Completeness pass: the pre-seed (2025-06, about 500K) rests on VCBacked, with the investor list from PitchBook (which says 510K); Network VC's investment is also announced by scroll.media (https://scroll.media/en/?p=18469) without an amount.
